metadata.title: Green Pulse Verified Emission Factors
metadata.description: Standardized, documented emission factors for calculating carbon footprints in Green Pulse. Sourced from the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) of India, UK DESNZ / DEFRA, IPCC Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, and DMRC Sustainability Reports.

motorcycle.name: Motorcycle / Scooter (Petrol 100-150cc)
motorcycle.source: UK DESNZ / DEFRA 2023 & ARAI Indian Commuter Average
motorcycle.description: Average Indian two-wheeler petrol consumption under urban commuting conditions.

bus.name: Public Transit Bus (City Route)
bus.source: Indian Urban Transit Bus Fleet Study & UK DESNZ 2023 (Occupancy adjusted)
bus.description: High-capacity municipal city bus with average daytime passenger occupancy of 40 passengers.

metro_rail.name: Metro Rail / Urban Electric Train
metro_rail.source: Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) Sustainability Report & CEA Grid Factor
metro_rail.description: Mass Rapid Transit System powered by electric traction from regional grid.

petrol_car.name: Petrol Car (Average Hatchback / Sedan)
petrol_car.source: UK DESNZ / DEFRA 2023 & MoRTH Indian Fleet Average
petrol_car.description: Average compact/midsize passenger car running on motor gasoline.

electric_car.name: Electric Vehicle (EV - Grid Charged)
electric_car.source: CEA India National Grid Factor (0.716 kg/kWh) × 0.15 kWh/km average EV consumption
electric_car.description: Battery electric four-wheeler charged using Indian national power grid electricity.

bicycle_walk.name: Bicycle / Walking (Active Transport)
bicycle_walk.source: GHG Protocol Guidelines for Personal Transportation

commercial_van.name: Commercial Delivery Van / LCV (Diesel)
commercial_van.source: UK DESNZ / DEFRA 2023 & Indian Commercial Fleet Benchmark
commercial_van.description: Light commercial vehicle used for campus logistics, campus courier, or business transport.

heavy_truck.name: Heavy Duty Freight Truck (>12t Diesel)
heavy_truck.description: Rigid/articulated heavy diesel cargo truck for raw materials and product distribution.

company_bus.name: Dedicated Employee Shuttle Bus (Diesel)
company_bus.source: ARAI Medium & Heavy Commercial Vehicle Fleet Baseline
company_bus.description: Company-chartered or owned commuter bus providing employee pickup and drop services.

grid_national.name: India National Grid Average Electricity
grid_national.source: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power, Govt. of India (CO2 Baseline Database v20.0)
grid_national.description: Weighted average emission factor of generation plants connected to the Indian National Grid.

grid_regional_thermal.name: Thermal Dominant Grid Mix (Coal/Gas)
grid_regional_thermal.source: CEA India State & Regional Specific Thermal Generation Baseline
grid_regional_thermal.description: Higher-carbon regional grid segment dominated by sub-critical coal-fired thermal generation.

solar_rooftop.name: Rooftop Solar PV (Self-Generated)
solar_rooftop.source: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) Lifecycle Assessment
solar_rooftop.scope: Lifecycle embodied emissions only (zero operational emissions)
solar_rooftop.description: Embodied lifecycle manufacturing and recycling emissions of crystalline silicon solar panels.

lpg.name: LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas - Cooking Cylinder)
lpg.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories / UK DESNZ 2023
lpg.description: Domestic cylinder LPG containing propane/butane mix commonly used in households and campus canteens.

petrol_direct.name: Petrol / Motor Spirit (Direct Fuel)
petrol_direct.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Table 3.2.1
petrol_direct.description: Direct chemical combustion of petrol in internal combustion engines.

diesel_direct.name: Diesel / High Speed Diesel (Direct Fuel)
diesel_direct.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Table 3.2.1
diesel_direct.description: Direct combustion of diesel in generator sets, pumps, and heavy transport.

cng.name: CNG (Compressed Natural Gas)
cng.description: Natural gas compressed for vehicles and domestic piped supply.

diesel_generator.name: Diesel Generator Power Backup (DG Set)
diesel_generator.source: Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) DG Emission Standard / IPCC 2006
diesel_generator.description: Diesel fuel consumed by on-site standby power generator sets during grid outages.

furnace_oil.name: Furnace Oil / Heavy Fuel Oil (Boilers)
furnace_oil.source: Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) Industrial Heat Baseline / IPCC 2006
furnace_oil.description: Heavy petroleum fraction burned in industrial steam boilers, furnaces, and thermal plants.

natural_gas_piped.name: Piped Natural Gas (PNG - Industrial)
natural_gas_piped.source: Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board (PNGRB) / DEFRA 2023
natural_gas_piped.description: Standard cubic metre of piped methane gas supplied via pipeline grid for industrial heating.

mixed_landfill.name: Mixed Municipal Solid Waste (Landfilled / Dumpsite)
mixed_landfill.source: IPCC Guidelines for Waste Management / DEFRA 2023
mixed_landfill.scope: Scope 3 (Waste disposal and methane fugitive release)
mixed_landfill.description: Unsegregated garbage ending up in municipal open landfills where anaerobic decomposition yields methane.

food_waste_landfill.name: Food / Organic Waste (Sent to Landfill)
food_waste_landfill.source: IPCC Guidelines & Waste and Resources Action Programme (WRAP)
food_waste_landfill.description: Kitchen and canteen biodegradable food scraps decaying under anaerobic landfill conditions.

composted_organic.name: Organic Waste Composted (Home / Campus Compost)
composted_organic.source: IPCC Tier 1 Method for Biological Treatment of Waste
composted_organic.description: Aerobic decomposition in well-aerated composters, preventing methane emissions.

segregated_recyclables.name: Dry Recyclables (Paper, Plastics, Metals, Glass)
segregated_recyclables.scope: Scope 3 (Handling and transport to formal recycling stream)
segregated_recyclables.description: Segregated clean dry waste sent to material recovery facilities.

industrial_scrap_metal.name: Industrial Scrap Metal (Recycled)
industrial_scrap_metal.source: International Aluminium Institute & World Steel Association LCA
industrial_scrap_metal.description: Ferrous and non-ferrous metal scrap diverted from landfill to secondary smelting.

hazardous_e_waste.name: Electronic Waste (E-Waste Recycled via SPCB Vendor)
hazardous_e_waste.source: CPCB E-Waste Management Rules & DEFRA Circular Economy Factor
hazardous_e_waste.description: Decommissioned computers, batteries, circuit boards processed by authorized recyclers.
